Package com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.geometry

Class GLine

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.react.events.EventEmitter
com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.geometry.GObject
com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.geometry.GLine
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventEmitterInterface, EventListener, IdempotentEventListener<GPointMovedEvent,Vector3>, CanCopy, DecomposeWhenDrawn<Segment>, HasParents<GTri>, SceneObject, HasProperties
public class GLine extends GObject implements HasParents<GTri>, IdempotentEventListener<GPointMovedEvent,Vector3>, DecomposeWhenDrawn<Segment>
GLine represents, you guessed it, a line.

A GLine's pivot is always defined as its midpoint.

A GLine is drawn by a parent GTri but otherwise is stored alongside other GObjects within a Thing. And a GLine also draws it's relevant GPoints

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
